cases.name: synthesized_defaults_v0
cases.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

cases.name: synthesized_defaults_v1
cases.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

cases.name: a_present_assignment
cases.why: The nullable struct is present, so the wire carries the one-byte marker followed by the struct body. This is the half no synthesized case reaches, and it is where a marker spelled as a varint would diverge from Kafka: both spellings are one byte, so only Kafka's own encoder can tell them apart.

cases.name: an_assignment_present_but_empty
cases.why: An empty struct is not a null struct: the marker says present and the body is an empty array. Absent and empty are two different frames and must stay two different frames.
